summary: USBC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an October 12, 2026 Second Addendum to its March 18, 2026 Master Loan Agreement with Payward Interactive, Inc., increasing the borrowing commitment from $25.0 million to $40.0 million; $21.0 million was outstanding, leaving $19.0 million available. Borrowings are secured by Bitcoin collateral custodied with Payward Financial, Inc., subject to margin maintenance and liquidation rights. A related account control agreement amendment adds cross-collateralization between the MLA and certain digital asset derivative transactions. No shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change of control is involved; this is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
